title: Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards Product Specification: Numbering, ID, Names, Designs and Gifting
content:
Every card in the Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program carries a 15-digit card number. The card types differ on whether photo ID is checked when the card is issued, whether the holder's name is recorded with the card, whether a custom message or logo can be printed, and whether the card can be given to another person.

## Specification by card type

| Card type | Card number format | Photo ID checked when the card is issued | Holder's name recorded with the card | Custom message or logo can be printed | Card can be given to another person |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | 15 digits | no | no | no | yes |
| Northgate eGift Card | 15 digits | no | no | yes | yes |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | 15 digits | yes | yes | no | yes |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | 15 digits | no | no | no | no |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | 15 digits | no | no | yes | yes |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | 15 digits | yes | yes | no | yes |

## Groupings that follow from the table

- **Photo ID at issue and a recorded holder name** go together: both apply to the Northgate Merchandise Return Card and the Northgate Reloadable Gift Card, and to no other type.
- **Custom message or logo printing** is available on the Northgate eGift Card and the Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card only.
- **Giving the card to another person** is allowed on every type except the Northgate Promotional Gift Card.

## Questions the specification answers

**Can a business have its logo printed on Northgate Business Bulk Gift Cards?** Yes; custom message or logo printing is available on that type.

**May a customer pass a Northgate Promotional Gift Card to a friend?** No; that type cannot be given to another person.

**Is a photo ID checked when a Northgate Gift Card is bought?** No; photo ID is checked at issue only for the Northgate Merchandise Return Card and the Northgate Reloadable Gift Card.
